{{Quote|He was beheaded&hellip;messily too.|Transmission from ''Band Light'', speaking of Pend|<ref name="FUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Pend''' was part of the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Band Light]]'', which was suspected of [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Terror" /> At some point before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he and the rest of the crew of the ''Band Light'' were checking out an [[Etti Lighter|''Etti''-class light transport]] that was floating adrift near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], when he [[Death/Legends|died]]. He was checking for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] goods in a ventilation shaft near the galley on the light [[Transport/Legends|transport]] when he was beheaded by an Imperial [[Terror Trooper]]. When his body was found, it was suspected by the [[Unidentified captain of the Band Light|captain]] and the other crew members that something had dislodged on the ship, fallen, and killed him.<ref name="Terror" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pend was mentioned in the "[[Terror Trooper]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="FUII" />
